title: 'Exploratory VARX: omit versus include lagged Z'
author: "Ace I. Mejia-Sanchez"
date: "2026-11-14"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This analysis fits LASSO twice to the **same** weak-dependence, weak-exogenous-effect dataset: once without lagged Z and once with lagged Z. The fitting code and score calculations are from the original source.

```{r}
source("00_requirements.R")
source("02_funct_MethodImplementation.R")
source("03_funct_ModelEvaluation.R")
load("data/simulation_objects.RData")
load("data/processed/lagged_designs.RData")

exo_omit_fit <- fit_equations(exo_data_as_VAR, method = "LASSO")
exo_include_fit <- fit_equations(exo_data_as_VARX, method = "LASSO")

# Same original score_fit calls, grouped into the VARX experiment only.
metrics <- do.call(rbind, c(
  list(
    score_fit(exo_omit_fit, A_weak, "VARX-generated data", "VAR(1): omit Z",
              B_true = B_weak),
    score_fit(exo_include_fit, A_weak, "VARX-generated data", "VARX(1,1): include Z",
              B_true = B_weak)
  )
))
rownames(metrics) <- NULL
print(metrics, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nTrue exogenous effects for Y1 and Y3:\n")
print(B_weak[c(1, 3)])
cat("\nLASSO VARX estimated exogenous effects for Y1 and Y3:\n")
print(exo_include_fit$B_hat[c(1, 3)])
cat("\nNumber of nonzero exogenous coefficients selected:\n")
print(sum(abs(exo_include_fit$B_hat) > 1e-7))

# Compare omitting vs including Z
exo_only <- subset(metrics, scenario == "VARX-generated data")
plot_exo <- ggplot(exo_only, aes(x = fitted_model, y = test_one_step_MSE)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.55, fill = "#538AB6") +
  labs(title = "Exploratory VARX comparison (LASSO with and without Z)",
       x = NULL, y = "Held-out one-step MSE") 

print(plot_exo)

# Organization only: save the two exploratory model fits and metrics.
save(exo_omit_fit, exo_include_fit, metrics,
     file = "data/processed/varx_exploration_results.RData")
```
